idea-plugin.name: Oracle JDK License Gate
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the Java lines in your build that Oracle now bills for, and the free line that replaces each one

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Oracle JDK License Gate: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 9 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/oracle-jdk-license-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/oracle-jdk-license-gate

action.text: Oracle JDK License Gate: Check This File
action.description: Run Oracle JDK License Gate on the file in the editor
